player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in Nim.
Your goal is to take the last remaining object.
On each turn, choose exactly one pile and remove one or more objects from it.
Use the format '[pile quantity]', where pile is the pile index and quantity is the number of objects to remove.
For example, '[0 3]' removes 3 objects from pile 0.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Janiw kuna wakichäwisa jikxatatäkiti. "[pile quantity]" ukampi lurma.
invalid_move.correct_format_wrong_fields: Player {player_id}, Jan wali k'anxa. Q'ara {col} ukaxa jan wali ñiq'it.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Indice de pila {pile_index} ukax janiw ukjamäkiti.
invalid_move.exceeds_pile: Janiraki {quantity} q'umach'a q'ara {pile_index} ñiq'it (ukaxa {pile_count} q'umach'a q'ara).

observation.removed_from_piles: Player {player_id} xaxwa [{pile_index} {quantity}], {quantity} q'umach'a q'ara {pile_index} ñiq'it q'umach'añaraki.
